regimens.dose_text: Starting dose: 0.25 mg three times daily (0.75 mg/day). Titrate weekly: Week 2: 0.5 mg TID; Week 3: 0.75 mg TID; Week 4: 1 mg TID. Then increase by up to 1.5 mg/day weekly up to 9 mg/day, and by up to 3 mg/day weekly up to maximum 24 mg/day.

refs.quote: Patients treated with ropinirole have reported falling asleep while engaged in activities of daily living, including driving or operating machinery, which sometimes resulted in accidents.

value.effect: CYP1A2 inhibitors (e.g. ciprofloxacin) significantly increase ropinirole concentrations; CYP1A2 inducers (e.g. cigarette smoking) increase clearance and lower levels.
value.management: Dose adjustments of ropinirole may be required when starting, stopping, or altering doses of CYP1A2 inhibitors or when smoking habits change.

refs.quote: Inhibitors or inducers of CYP1A2: May alter the clearance of ropinirole; dose adjustment of ropinirole may be required.

value.effect: Dopamine D2 antagonists diminish the therapeutic effectiveness of ropinirole.
value.management: Avoid concomitant administration; if neuroleptic therapy is needed, prefer quetiapine or clozapine.

refs.quote: Dopamine antagonists (e.g., neuroleptics, metoclopramide): May reduce efficacy of ropinirole.

value.effect: Estrogens reduce ropinirole clearance, increasing systemic exposure.
value.management: Starting or stopping HRT during ropinirole treatment may require dosage adjustments of ropinirole.

refs.quote: Hormone replacement therapy (HRT): Starting or stopping HRT may require dose adjustment of ropinirole.
